use default

middle_square(seed: int) -> Pipe[int] is
    let current mut = seed

    while true do
        let squared = "{cast long(current) * cast long(current),012}"

        current = int.parse(squared.substring(3, 6))

        yield current
    od
si

for value in middle_square(675248) |> take(5) do
    write_line("{value}")
od
